# smallvis

`smallvis` is an R package for experimenting with neighborhood embedding
methods, including t-SNE, LargeVis, and UMAP cost functions. You can
control input scaling, nearest neighbors, initialization, and
optimization to compare methods and try out ideas.

Install from GitHub with `pak::pak("jlmelville/smallvis/smallvis")`. The
R package lives in the `smallvis` subdirectory of the repository.

Start with the examples in the [function
reference](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/package/reference/smallvis.md),
then see the [usage
guide](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/package/articles/usage.md)
for other embedding methods and options. The [research
articles](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/) explore the theory and
experiments behind the package.

# Package index

## Create embeddings

- [`smallvis()`](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/package/reference/smallvis.md)
  : Dimensionality Reduction via Neighbor Embedding
- [`smallvis_rep()`](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/package/reference/smallvis_rep.md)
  : Best t-SNE Result From Multiple Initializations
- [`smallvis_perpstep()`](https://jlmelville.github.io/smallvis/package/reference/smallvis_perpstep.md)
  : Dimensionality Reduction With Perplexity Stepping
